svg.title: Testing Pyramid
svg.desc: Testing Pyramid. Many fast unit tests, fewer integration and contract tests, a few end-to-end tests: feedback stays fast and failures point at the cause. Step 1, The ice-cream cone: 640 browser tests run nightly for 95 min, 7% of runs flaky: red means re-run, so bugs reach staging. Step 2, The test pyramid: Fast tests at the base: the tax bug fails one unit test after 40 s, naming TaxCalculator.round(). Step 3, Fast layers first: Base first, each layer on a time budget: green in 12 min; flaky tests quarantined; test the risks. Step 4, Pitfalls and other shapes: Pitfalls: drifting mocks, shape-only contracts, a regrowing E2E suite, gamed coverage; other shapes.

g.text: 640 browser tests run nightly for 95 min, 7% of runs flaky: red means re-run, so bugs reach staging.
Fast tests at the base: the tax bug fails one unit test after 40 s, naming TaxCalculator.round().
Base first, each layer on a time budget: green in 12 min; flaky tests quarantined; test the risks.
Pitfalls: drifting mocks, shape-only contracts, a regrowing E2E suite, gamed coverage; other shapes.
